svg.text: ROUTE FIRST · WHEN IN DOUBT, THE MORE EXPENSIVE LANE · A LANE GOES UP, NEVER SILENTLY DOWN
Can you PROVE it changes no executable behavior, stored data, permissions, integration or deployment?
If you cannot prove it, it is code. The burden of proof is on the cheap lane, not the expensive one.
The other four end at their bar. Only the middle one goes down to the five steps.
If a gate fails, fix the TEST before the code
Before escalating it as a decision
Two failures of the same hypothesis
Runs in parallel, without seeing the calculation
Only now are the two compared
If a gate fails, back to the step
THE THREE TRANSVERSAL RULES · THEY HOLD OVER EVERY LANE, THEY ARE NOT ANOTHER STEP
Every claim is a hypothesis until measured
The instrument is calibrated on the real
corpus, and whoever calibrates says what
A line enters the method only if it turns
